name: Deck Slide Carousel
description: Horizontal snap-scroll carousel where photos stack like a deck of cards and fly off with a rotation as you scroll, with a color-shifting background, rolling oversized captions and a numeric progress indicator.
contents: Optional heading label at the top
Stacked photo deck, one image per slide
Large serif caption roller at the bottom
Fallback message for browsers without scroll-driven animations
behavior: Horizontal scroll with snap drives all animations through CSS scroll-driven timelines
Top photo rotates and slides off to the left while the next one settles
Background color cross-fades to each slide's color
Captions roll vertically and stretch with scroll velocity
Browsers without scroll-timeline support show only the fallback text

props.name: fallbackText
props.default: This browser does not support scroll-driven animations.

editableByProps: Slides, images, captions, per-slide background colors and heading
Base and text colors, fonts, caption size and opacity
Photo aspect, rotations and exit motion, scroll smoothing

needsCodeEdit.change: Move the counter indicator to the right side
needsCodeEdit.where: showIndicator block with the left-7 class
bg-white classes inside the showIndicator block

fixed: Relies on CSS scroll-driven animations and timeline-scope, supported in current Chromium browsers only, others see the fallback text
Root is at least one viewport tall and clips its overflow
Photo width is capped at 80% of the stage width so it fits small screens
